notes.title: Mark of the Deep Now $19.99 – Permanent Price Drop + New Update Live!
notes.content:
Hey Adventurers,

We’ve got exciting news: Mark of the Deep is now permanently priced at [b]$19.99 USD[/b]!

While game prices across the industry continue to climb, we’re heading in a different direction. This new, lower price reflects our long-term commitment to supporting the game and growing our community of daring explorers.

Alongside the price drop, we’ve shipped a new update focused on quality-of-life improvements and polish, including:
[list]
[*] [b]Full Mouse and Keyboard Remapping Support[/b]: Customize your inputs exactly how you like.
[*] [b]Progression Bug Fixes[/b]: We’ve resolved several blockers to ensure smoother progression.
[*] [b]Performance Optimizations[/b]: The game now runs more reliably across a wider range of hardware.
[*] [b]Miscellaneous Tweaks and Polish[/b]: Small refinements based on your feedback.
[/list]Whether you’ve been waiting to jump in or looking to return, now is a perfect time to explore the depths. If you’ve already purchased Mark of the Deep, thank you. Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping the game.

We’ll have more updates to share in the coming months, so stay tuned. In the meantime, feel free to leave a review or join the conversation on the Steam forums.

Thanks for all your support,
The Mad Mimic Team

notes.title: Mark of the Deep – Major Gameplay Update and New Bundle!
notes.content:
Greetings, Adventurers!

Today marks a major update for Mark of the Deep, directly inspired by your invaluable feedback. This update introduces significant gameplay improvements, new mechanics, and quality-of-life enhancements to ensure your adventures feel better than ever.

We're also excited to announce a special collaboration bundle with the acclaimed roguelike Curse of the Dead Gods.

[h3]Update Highlights:[/h3]

[b]Enemy Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Enemy Stagger System:[/b]
Enemies and bosses can now be staggered after consecutive hits, adding depth and strategy to combat. The stagger amount scales with the Rookie’s attacks.
[*] [b]Boss Rebalancing:[/b]
[*] [b]Takon:[/b] Enhanced damage and faster animations make for a more challenging and dynamic encounter.
[*] [b]Nereida:[/b] Completely redesigned fight, tailored for better integration with core gameplay.
[/list]
[b]Rookie Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Enhanced Roll Mechanics:[/b]
Rookie now moves faster immediately after rolling, and rolls can interrupt basic attacks at any time for increased fluidity.
[*] [b]Adjusted Hookshot:[/b]
A new minimum distance requirement has been added, ensuring strategic positioning is essential.
[/list]
[b]Introducing the In-Game Map[/b]
[list]
[*] A biome-level map is now available, clearly indicating Rookie’s current position and biome names.
[*] It also highlights biomes where Angry Mermaid crew members await rescue, while preserving the sense of exploration by leaving finer details to be discovered.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44145687/a7b72fe7c250da27f68741567d02e95c14b4b33a.png[/img]
[h3]Watch the New Gameplay Video[/h3]

Check out our new video showcasing these major enhancements, alongside screenshots of the newly introduced in-game map.

[previewyoutube=WspWdmBx_es;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New Bundle: Curse of the Dead Gods X Mark of the Deep[/h3]

We're thrilled to announce a partnership with the hit roguelike, Curse of the Dead Gods! Explore both games in this bundle and experience the best of action-adventure roguelikes.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49584/Curse_of_the_Dead_Gods_X_Mark_of_the_Deep_Bundle/

[h3]Keep the Feedback Coming![/h3]

Your thoughtful reviews and feedback have directly shaped these improvements. Please continue to share your experiences and suggestions, as it helps us immensely in our ongoing development journey.

Thanks for your support, and enjoy the updated adventure!

— The Mad Mimic Team

notes.title: Quick Hotfix – Leviathan Soft Lock & Journal Fix
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We just rolled out a small update to fix a couple of issues some players ran into:

[list]
[*] Fixed a soft lock that could happen after talking to the Leviathan.
[*] Fixed an issue with Caelen's journal in the Royal Garden.
[/list]
This should be live on all platforms now. If you run into anything else, let us know. We’re keeping an eye on your feedback.

Thanks for playing and for all the support!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.0.2 Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We just released Patch 1.0.0.0.2! We appreciate your support, and every bit of feedback helps us continue refining the game.

Patch Notes:
✅ Fixed an issue where a crash during the Leviathan Cutscene could cause a softlock, preventing gates from reopening. Now, the gates will always open when reloading.
✅ Fixed an issue where keyboard bindings were not saving properly.
✅ Fixed minor localization issues across various languages.
✅ Fixed a bug where a potion appeared in the inventory before the player had acquired one.
✅ Implemented a new font for Traditional and Simplified Chinese for better readability.

[h2][b]We’d Love to Hear From You[/b][/h2]

If you're enjoying Mark of the Deep or have suggestions for improvements, consider leaving an honest review on Steam. Your feedback helps us understand what’s working, what could be better, and what features you’d like to see in future updates.

notes.title: Mark of the Deep is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Ahoy, adventurers!

The wait is over—Mark of the Deep is officially available, and to celebrate, it’s 15% off for the first 10 days!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933370/Mark_of_the_Deep/

We are also launching a supporter pack at [b]$7.99[/b], along with a digital deluxe edition at [b]$34.99[/b]!

Step into the boots of Marcus "Rookie" Ramsey, a pirate stranded on a cursed island teeming with danger, mystery, and treasure. Battle fierce foes, uncover hidden secrets, and harness the power of Marks to rescue your crew and unravel the island’s dark curse.

[previewyoutube=k4MrVUJpQiU;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*] A fully-voiced campaign with branching choices and multiple endings
[*] Challenging combat with 80+ unique enemies and 16 bosses
[*] Exploration powered by abilities unlocked through mysterious Marks
[*] A rich, narrative-driven adventure set in an interconnected world
[/list]
We’d love to hear your thoughts as you embark on your journey in Mark of the Deep! Leaving a review not only supports the team but also helps us continue improving the game.

We also have a Discord server, where the team is available for questions/feedback. Join the community at: https://discord.gg/jruN2DxAYt


Thank you for embarking on this journey with us. We’re eager to hear about the secrets you uncover, the enemies you conquer, and the stories you create in Mark of the Deep.

Happy exploring,
Mad Mimic

notes.title: Mark of the Deep Sets Sail January 24, 2025 – Updated Demo Now Live
notes.content:
Ahoy, adventurers!

We’re excited to announce that Mark of the Deep will officially launch on January 24, 2025.

[b]Updated Demo – New Challenges Await[/b]
To give you a fresh taste of the action, we’ve updated the free demo with some exciting new features:
[list]
[*] Speedrun Mode: Race against time with a built-in runtime counter.
[*] No-Hit Challenges: Master combat by taking no damage.
[*] No-Death Runs: Test your resolve and make it through without a single misstep.
[/list]These additions offer a challenging experience for newcomers and seasoned explorers alike.

[b]New Cinematic Trailer[/b]
We’ve also released a brand-new cinematic trailer, giving you a closer look at the cursed isle’s treacherous depths. Watch it here:

[previewyoutube=X6li8AJsMQM;full][/previewyoutube]
We’re grateful for your continued support as we get closer to launch. Be sure to try out the updated demo, and if you haven’t already, add Mark of the Deep to your wishlist to stay up to date with the latest news.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933370/Mark_of_the_Deep/

See you on the shores of the cursed isle!

The Mad Mimic Team

notes.title: NEW MARK OF THE DEEP DEMO AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Greetings, crew! As we eagerly await the release of Mark of the Deep, join us in a brand new [b]demo available for everyone[/b] to get a taste of this epic pirate-themed adventure with a strong narrative and a thrilling mix of Metroidvania and Souls-Like elements.

As a newfound Mark Keeper, Rookie can unlock new abilities that change how you fight enemies and explore the environments! Discover new skills, weapons and trinkets to upgrade your combat abilities and make your way through new areas of the island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44145687/0bcff71c74d84a30e5fb52f006fff7a157a95235.gif[/img]

Meet a fully-voiced cast of pirates, abyssal creatures and many other characters trapped in a cursed island with you! Rescue old friends and make new allies as you unravel the mysteries of the native inhabitants of the island: the Old Folks.

And for the first time, players are able to explore the island and discover its mysteries in 10 different languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, German, French, Russian and Turkish (plus Japanese in the next updates).

[h3]JOIN OUR CREW [/h3]

If you want to reach us to talk about the demo, we're available to chat with you at anytime on our Discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/madmimic]https://discord.gg/madmimic[/url]. Let us know your thoughts and feedbacks about the game. And if you like it, don't forget to [b]add Mark of the Deep to your Steam wishlist! [/b]

notes.title: SIGN UP for the NEW MARK OF THE DEEP PLAYTEST until May 15th!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933370/Mark_of_the_Deep/][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44145687/bb142411111bd113a342611269b5e0d99469f8b4.png[/img][/url]

Greetings, crew! Who's excited for Mark of the Deep full launch this year?

After our first playtest in April, we decided to alter the structure of Mark of the Deep beta and introduce more game areas in this version. In the previous beta you explored Tidal Stronghold, while in this one Rookie can progress through four new areas: 
[list]
[*]Leviathan Temple
[*]Western Ruins
[*]Under Ruins
[*]Fishing Village
[/list]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44145687/3dd0a4d96a56aad2b9fec513b8a828255512c4a5.gif[/img]

To test the new beta, just [b]sign up for the Mark of the Deep Playtest[/b], wait until it appears in your library and play! Players who received an invite to the previous playtest still have access to this new playtest, you simply need to update the game on Steam. But for new players: hurry up as spots are limited!

Signing up is super easy and quick: just open the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933370/Mark_of_the_Deep/?utm_source=insta&utm_medium=story&utm_campaign=t&utm_id=Insta-T]game page[/url], find the playtest section under the screenshots and click [b]Request Access[/b]. This will grant access to players and the trial version will be available in your Steam library.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933370/Mark_of_the_Deep/?utm_source=insta&utm_medium=story&utm_campaign=t&utm_id=Insta-T][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44145687/81ff29473b95d0f463a064ea6978c094975e190b.png[/img][/url]

After playing a bit of Rookie’s adventure, tell us what you think about Mark of the Deep in our [url=https://forms.gle/uJiMkXeGn3XFB2LX7][b]feedback formulary[/b][/url] or in our [b][url=https://discord.gg/madmimic]Discord server[/url][/b]! Your feedbacks and suggestions help us to develop a better game for launch.

And don’t forget to add Mark of the Deep to your wishlist! 

[url=https://discord.gg/madmimic][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44145687/13afcb8f67dc7956009d83a86c31056e9e5b78d8.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: PLAYTEST EXTENDED - Tell us your thoughts and feedbacks about Mark of the Deep!
notes.content:
[url=https://forms.gle/zNxrUvRtWfMN55tP6][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44145687/e7d8b62cce267ba3e60aad9a9c05b9436bbe6d73.png[/img][/url]

Greetings, crew! We have great news about the Mark of the Deep Playtest. 🏴‍☠️

Firstly, thanks everyone for subscribing for the Mark of the Deep Playtest, specially the players who gave us their feedbacks about the game. We’re thrilled to announce a [b]Playtest extension[/b], which will be [b]available until May 1st[/b]: just sign up to the Playtest and the beta version will be in your Library [b]instantly[/b]!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44145687/81ff29473b95d0f463a064ea6978c094975e190b.png[/img]

We would love to know more of your opinions on this beta of the game, and that's why we came up with a [url=https://forms.gle/ydBsR6aCNhjjtxVt6][b]Playtest Feedback Form[/b][/url] where you can tell us more details of your thoughts about Mark of the Deep gameplay, combat and performance. Filling it with your feedbacks and suggestions help us to develop an even better game at launch!

Here's the link: [b][url=https://forms.gle/ydBsR6aCNhjjtxVt6 ]https://forms.gle/ydBsR6aCNhjjtxVt6 [/url][/b]

Besides, we would like to announce that we updated this beta version to fix some bugs and improve the overall gameplay based on your feedbacks. Some of them include:

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Skeleton Warden (the skeleton with a shield) hitbox fixed
[*] Some enemy locations changed 
[*] We changed how enemies will track the player during an attack. Before it was too precise, giving an unfair feel to the combat. Now the player has a bigger time window to avoid attacks.
[/list]
[b]Visual Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Ghost models updated to Skeleton Ghost models
[*] Player UI font updated
[*] Vendor, Journal and Stone Tablet screens updated
[/list]
[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved performance when interacting with breakable objects
[/list]
And please don't forget to add the game to your wishlist! 💚
